children: SR Bancorp, Inc. reported fiscal year 2026 net income of $3.4M, down from $5.1M in FY2025, on revenue measured as net interest income of $31.2M versus $29.6M a year earlier.
Revenue (net interest income) was $31.2M for year ended June 30, 2026, compared with $29.6M in FY2025; YoY change 5.6%.
Net income was $3.4M for year ended June 30, 2026, compared with $5.1M in FY2025; YoY change (33.3%).
Diluted earnings per share: not provided in the extracted sections.
Completed a mutual-to-stock conversion and Nasdaq listing and merged Regal Bancorp to expand its New Jersey branch footprint and product capabilities.
Originations and loan purchases drove approximately 13% loan growth, with expansion in residential, multi-family and commercial real estate lending.
Shift in deposit mix toward core and interest-bearing demand balances through competitive pricing and a focus on commercial relationships.
Continued investments in digital channels—online/mobile banking, mobile deposit, Zelle and online loan applications—to improve customer convenience and operational efficiency.
Maintained high asset quality with no non-performing loans and disciplined underwriting, supported by ACL modeling and ALCO oversight.
